title: Content Creation?
author: requiem
body:
Maybe I should get into content creation, it'd help my anxiety. I used to make youtube videos when I was younger, and even though the quality was bad I liked doing it. 

I think I'll try to do:
Horror games
General variety games
and Occasional tech videos

More than that, it will probably help my BPD and it's constant approval/validation seeking, but thats a double edged sword... Worth a shot I guess :p
